title: TherapyGym: Evaluating and Aligning Clinical Fidelity and Safety in Therapy Chatbots

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing and calibrating LLM-based judge ratings of therapy conversations against expert human clinician ratings using correlation metrics (Spearman's rank, Pearson's r, and Krippendorff's alpha) on a validation set (TherapyJudgeBench) to measure and mitigate systematic deviations in the automated evaluator.
